original_review.key_result: Cold-first active_chunk_id plus active_chunk_label plus route_sequence defeated a conflicting wrong next_chunk_id. After move_on, the assistant advanced to collect_dishes rather than stack_papers and the run was classified PASS_CANDIDATE.
original_review.language_lesson: The ordered route_sequence can act as the authoritative legal route even when packet-level next_chunk fields conflict, as long as the packet includes active chunk identity and the sequence. This retires the active+label+route_sequence wrong-next control and shifts the minimum-carrier question to whether the active label is still necessary.

pointer_update.purpose: Test whether active_chunk_id plus route_sequence, without active_chunk_label, is enough to carry legal move_on advancement and defeat a conflicting wrong next_chunk_id in a fresh cold-first chat.
evidence_reviewed: route_law_min_combo_cold_first_active_route_sequence_v1 showed active_chunk_id plus active_chunk_label plus route_sequence can advance cold to collect_dishes.
route_law_min_combo_cold_first_sequence_wrong_next_control_v1 showed the same carrier set defeats a conflicting next_chunk_id pointing to stack_papers.
The latest run completed with no tool failure, no warnings, and assistant response New active chunk: collect_dishes.
pointer_update.open_gap: The passing cold wrong-next packet still included active_chunk_label, so we do not yet know whether active_chunk_id plus route_sequence alone is sufficient.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run one fresh disposable chat with a single cold case containing active_chunk_id, allowed_intents, route_sequence, and a conflicting next_chunk_id/next_chunk_label pointing to stack_papers. Omit active_chunk_label. The legal result should still be collect_dishes.
avoid: do not run the next control in the already warmed chat
do not include active_chunk_label in the next packet
do not add response_contract wording that rescues the route
do not bundle multiple cold cards into one warmed suite
do not treat active_id plus route_sequence as proven until the wrong-next conflict control passes without active_chunk_label
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: One-case cold-first suite in a fresh disposable chat.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire this pointer when a cold packet with active_chunk_id plus route_sequence, no active_chunk_label, and conflicting wrong next_chunk_id advances to collect_dishes rather than stack_papers.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate only the validator-ready one-case JSON suite for route_law_min_combo_cold_first_active_id_route_sequence_wrong_next_v1.
